def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, IntVal, Solver, Or, Not, And, sat
    
    st = Int('st')
    tag = Int('tag')
    i = Int('i')
    nb_streams = Int('nb_streams')
    codec_id = Int('codec_id')
    codec_type = Int('codec_type')
    st_id = Int('st_id')
    ch_id = Int('ch_id')
    
    TAG_JPEG2 = IntVal(0)
    TAG_STREAMBLOCK = IntVal(1)
    TAG_VIDEOFRAME = IntVal(2)
    TAG_STREAMHEAD = IntVal(3)
    TAG_STREAMHEAD2 = IntVal(4)
    TAG_VIDEOSTREAM = IntVal(5)
    
    AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG = IntVal(10)
    AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO = IntVal(20)
    AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO = IntVal(21)
    
    s = Solver()
    
    s.add(st == 0)
    
    s.add(Or(tag != TAG_JPEG2,
             Not(And(codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG, st_id == -2))))
    
    s.add(Or(tag != TAG_STREAMBLOCK,
             Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, st_id == -1))))
    
    s.add(Or(tag != TAG_VIDEOFRAME,
             Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, st_id == ch_id))))
    
    s.add(Or(Not(Or(tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD, tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD2)),
             Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, st_id == -1))))
    
    s.add(Or(tag != TAG_VIDEOSTREAM,
             Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, st_id == ch_id))))
    
    return s.check() == sat
